key.name: url
key.description: Base URL of the Home Assistant server, for example https://homeassistant.local:8123. The access token is not stored here: it is kept in the keyring.

key.name: credentials-revision
key.description: Changed by the preferences each time the access token in the keyring is saved or removed, so that the extension reads it again. Holds no secret.

key.name: topbar-label
key.description: Home Assistant label of the entities shown as chips in the top bar.

key.name: alert-label
key.description: Home Assistant label that, added to a top bar entity, shows its chip as an alert.

key.name: grid-label
key.description: Home Assistant label of the entity whose "tiles" attribute describes the Quick Settings grid.

key.name: download-icons
key.description: Download the mdi: icons used by Home Assistant from the jsDelivr CDN (once per icon, then cached). When off, only the icons shipped with the extension and those already cached are shown.

key.name: companion-enabled
key.summary: Register this computer in Home Assistant
key.description: When on, the computer is registered as a mobile_app device: it reports sensors, receives commands and shows notifications.

key.name: device-name
key.description: Name of this computer in Home Assistant, used when it is registered. Empty: the host name.

key.name: companion-snapshot
key.description: JSON {"deviceName", "notifyService", "notifyVerified", "entities": {sensor id: entity_id}} written by the extension once the computer is registered; the preferences generate the Home Assistant package from it.

key.name: shortcuts
key.description: JSON list of {"tile": mini-tile id, "choice": entity_id of one of its choices or null, "accel": accelerator}. Edited in the extension preferences.

key.name: grid-snapshot
key.description: JSON list of {"id", "name", "hasAction", "choices": [{"entityId", "name"}]} written by the extension from the Home Assistant grid. hasAction is false for a mini-tile whose action is "none".

key.name: shortcut-conflicts
key.summary: Shortcuts that could not be activated
key.description: One JSON array [tile, choice or null, accel] per entry of "shortcuts" whose accelerator the Shell refused to grab, written by the extension: already taken by another shortcut, already used by an earlier entry, or not a valid accelerator.
